metadata.description: Claude Cafe — plugins that bring the cast to life.

plugins.name: cafe-bell
plugins.description: Pub/sub hub for Claude Code hook events. Forwards every hook to a local SSE bus any consumer (voice player, dashboards) can subscribe to.

plugins.name: maid-vibe
plugins.description: The liveliness layer — time-aware greeting, a mood-marker reply cue, and a /look command that work across any persona.

plugins.name: maid-persona
plugins.description: Puts a maid on shift — injects the chosen persona from the maids cast at session start so Claude speaks in character.
